author: samcm
content:
Hello friends! We have some updates to The Lab that may be useful for both EL & CL devs:

- A brand new [Clients](https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/clients) section focused around diversity, with data derived from block graffiti & p2p node counts
- A deep dive section on each client: https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/clients/lighthouse that also allows you to drill down in to the rollouts of each version (e.g. https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/clients/lighthouse/v8.3.2)
- A new [Execution performance](https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/execution/performance) dashboard with some very interesting metrics derived from our EIP7870 nodes and their block execution timings (check out the `Methodology` sections on each card for more info)
- A new [Validators](https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/validators) section to track overall validator-set metrics
